summary: Digital Realty Trust, Inc. filed an 8-K on May 4, 2026, announcing entry into an ATM equity offering sales agreement with multiple agents to sell up to $7.5 billion of its common stock from time to time. This is a routine at-the-market equity issuance, not a special situation. The filing contains no M&A, activist, restructuring, or other transformative event. It is an ordinary shelf take-down under an existing program. Therefore, the category is None.
